report.headline: VIC1 5-minute RRP peaked at 406.00544 $/MWh at 2026-08-20 09:10 AEST (interval end 2026-08-19T23:10:00Z) (evidence ev0436); the Hazelwood 220 kV bus‑tie outage notice reports an outage at 2026-08-20 11:00 AEST, after that peak (market_notice_144893).
summary: The price extreme: 406.00544 $/MWh at interval ending 2026-08-19T23:10:00Z (local 2026-08-20 09:10 AEST).

The Hazelwood PS 4 6 bus tie 220kV notice (AEMO market notice 144893) gives 2026-08-20 11:00 AEST (2026-08-20T01:00:00Z), which is after the price extreme (interval ending 2026-08-19T23:10:00Z = 2026-08-20 09:10 AEST) and after the last 5-minute interval at-or-above the $300/MWh analysis threshold (interval ending 2026-08-19T23:45:00Z = 2026-08-20 09:45 AEST).
Dispatch TOTALDEMAND at the 5-minute price peak = 6639.92 MW (ev0437) and NETINTERCHANGE at that peak = -718.24 (net flow into VIC1) (ev0438).
Operational demand for the half-hour containing the peak (half-hour ending 2026-08-19T23:30:00Z) = 6812.0 MW (ev0912); the window maximum operational demand = 7485.0 MW (ev0930).
There were 6 five-minute intervals at-or-above the $300.0 $/MWh analysis threshold (ev0945; threshold ev0946).
SCADA-observed generator changes in the 22:00–23:30Z window include MURRAY -277.2 MW (ev0949), MREHA3 -196.16 MW (ev0952) and MREHA1 -148.31 MW (ev0955) (descriptive SCADA observations).

possible_explanations.statement: The Hazelwood PS 4 6 bus‑tie outage notice [c1] might refer to a later, separate outage and therefore might not correspond to the 2026-08-19T23:10:00Z price spike.
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Check the Network Outage Scheduler and constraint invocation logs for any Hazelwood bus‑tie outage or constraint invocation before or at 2026-08-19T23:10:00Z (interval end 2026-08-19T23:10:00Z = 2026-08-20 09:10 AEST).

possible_explanations.statement: Local supply tightness (high dispatch TOTALDEMAND and net import) might have contributed to the 406.00544 $/MWh 5‑minute RRP at 2026-08-19T23:10:00Z.
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Examine constraint binding reports and dispatch constraint sets for intervals ending 2026-08-19T23:05:00Z and 2026-08-19T23:10:00Z (use 2026-08-19T23:10:00Z as the target interval) to see which constraints were binding and whether interconnector limits or local constraints were active.

possible_explanations.statement: Observed generator output reductions (for example MURRAY -277.2 MW [ev0949], MREHA3 -196.16 MW [ev0952], MREHA1 -148.31 MW [ev0955]) might have reduced available supply, which could be related to the price spike.
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Obtain generator availability/outage records and dispatch targets for the units listed for the intervals up to 2026-08-19T23:30:00Z to determine whether the observed SCADA reductions reflect outages, dispatch reductions, or bid changes.
